name: element.find_invoke
description: Compound: element.find + element.invoke in one round-trip. Avoids the two-call latency for the common find-then-click pattern.

root.description: Optional window handle to scope the search. If omitted, searches the desktop root.

name.description: Accessible name to match (UIA Name / AX kAXTitle). Case-insensitive substring.

automation_id.description: Stable automation identifier; preferred over `name` when available.

timeout_ms.description: Time to keep retrying the find before returning ERR not_found. Default 2000 ms (mirrors element.find); pass 0 to disable retry.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`. Failures of either step surface as the relevant ERR (`not_found` / `uia_blind` from find; `not_supported_by_target` / `target_gone` from invoke).

x-implementations.name: uia_find_then_invoke
x-implementations.description: Internal: element.find followed by element.invoke. The intermediate elt:N id is allocated, used, and discarded within the verb call (not returned to the caller).

windows-modern.description: FindFirst + InvokePattern.Invoke. Internal allocation of the intermediate element id; not returned to the caller. Halts on the first error (find or invoke) and surfaces it.
